summary: Ingress transform strips tenant binding when SAML NameID contains '/' – audit role 403 in private deployment
description: Issue summary: After a SAML SSO login in the customer's private VPC, users with the tenant-scoped 'audit-reader' role receive 403 when calling admin audit endpoints. Impact: All users whose SAML NameID contains a slash character ('/') lose the tenant_bind claim and are mapped to no-tenant, causing RBAC to deny access. Environment: Private deployment in prod:us-west behind customer-managed ingress; Redwood identity proxy v2.8.1; ingress transform chain enabled (header-sanitizer -> jwt-enricher -> tenant-bind-resolver). Steps to reproduce: 1) Configure IdP to emit NameID with format 'urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:unspecified' and value containing '/'. 2) Log in via SSO and call GET /admin/audit/events with audit-reader credentials. 3) Observe 403 and absence of X-Redwood-Tenant header in request to backend. Expected behavior: tenant_bind claim preserved and X-Redwood-Tenant set to customer's tenant id; RBAC allows audit-reader access. Actual behavior: ingress transform removes tenant_bind (empty header) and request is evaluated as unauthenticated tenant-scoped call. Logs/artifacts: excerpt from ingress access log: "2026-03-10T14:23:02Z 403 GET /admin/audit/events tenant=(none) principal=acct:auditor@example.com nameid='dept/analytics'"; IdP SAML response (redacted) shows NameID=dept/analytics and AttributeStatement includes tenant_bind=tenant-845. Attached screenshots provided by customer in initial report.

investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: token/claim normalization bug in header sanitizer. Repro steps confirmed failure occurs only when NameID contains reserved path character '/'. Traced pipeline: SAML response -> proxy SAML parser (preserves tenant_bind attr) -> jwt-enricher maps tenant_bind->X-Redwood-Tenant -> header-sanitizer runs a path normalization pass that rewrites headers with characters matching path separators. The sanitizer used a naive regex that considered '/' unsafe and removed the header value entirely. Risk analysis: affects only private deployments with header-sanitizer enabled and IdPs that include '/' in NameID; likely to impact other attributes with path characters. Temporary mitigation: disable header-sanitizer or add explicit allowlist entries for tenant-related headers. Permanent fix: encode NameID-derived headers before sanitizer or update sanitizer to treat header values (not header names) as opaque and not apply path normalization.
resolution: Fix deployed in edge-ingress v2.8.2: ingress transform now percent-encodes NameID-derived claim values before sanitizer and adds a unit test for NameID characters including '/', '\\', and spaces. Customer verification: Datum Health confirmed on 2026-03-12 that audit endpoints now return 200 for affected users. Rollout notes: patch rolled to customer's private control plane during maintenance window 2026-03-12 03:00-03:15 UTC; no further errors observed. Follow-up actions: add runbook entry linking sanitizer allowlist and add automated regression test in CI. Linked internal ticket INT-4421 created to track runbook update and post-deploy audit.
